An adult Western centered on U.S. Marshal Matt Dillon and the people of Dodge City, using frontier crime and conflict to tell unusually serious stories about law, violence, survival, and community.

Adult-oriented CBS Western set in and around Dodge City. GRH contains 474 playable archive objects. The June 18, 1961 broadcast is the archive endpoint; specialist histories distinguish the last new story from the final rebroadcast.

GRH documents the program through CBS radio run (April 26, 1952 to June 18, 1961) on CBS Radio Network.

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are William Conrad (performer on 441 recordings and writer on 1 recording), Parley Baer (performer on 426 recordings), Georgia Ellis (performer on 384 recordings), George Walsh (announcer on 372 recordings), Howard McNear (performer on 361 recordings), Norman Macdonnell (director on 330 recordings, producer on 267 recordings, writer on 11 recordings, performer on 2 recordings, transcriber on 2 recordings, and radio adaptor on 1 recording), and John Meston (writer on 213 recordings, editorial supervisor on 101 recordings, and story editor on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to CBS Radio Network (broadcast on network) and Armed Forces Radio and Television Service (rebroadcast by).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include Murder and violent crime, Frontier law enforcement, Family and domestic conflict, Robbery and theft, Cattle and ranching, and Frontier medicine.
